name: EA LiDAR Composite DTM 1 m: local cached terrain pyramid
attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2022.
overview_note: Official coloured terrain rendering cached locally and aligned to the exact contributing-area/network EPSG:3857 outer bounds. It is the runtime source for the local tile pyramid and is not a 1 m numerical DEM.
tile_matrix_set: Local WebMercator XYZ generated in browser Worker
tile_matrix_order: XYZ z/x/y, north-west origin, aligned with OSM / MapLibre
display_rule: v3.15.0: no live EA WMS/WMTS requests at runtime. The cached local overview is cropped and resampled into WebMercator XYZ tiles in a browser Worker; MapLibre overzooms the local pyramid above maxzoom. This removes remote-service gaps and seams. Visible detail is limited by the cached overview resolution.
